tools.name: get_api_info
tools.description: Get full details of a specific Zyla API by its numeric ID. Returns the API name, description, category, price per successful call (USD), average latency (ms), and all endpoints with their parameters, example values, and a formal JSON Schema (input_schema) for argument validation.

tools.name: call_api
tools.description: Call an API endpoint on Zyla API Hub. Requires the user's API key and a credit card on file. Billing is pay-per-successful-request: you only pay for 2xx responses. tools.name: browse_catalog
tools.description: Browse the full Zyla API Hub catalog with pagination. Use this to explore ALL public APIs beyond the top 500. Supports filtering by category and search keyword. Returns paginated results with total count and page info.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available API categories on Zyla API Hub with the real count of public APIs in each. Use the category names returned here as the "category" parameter in browse_catalog to filter APIs by category. Example categories: Sports, Finance, Data, Science, etc.

findings.detail: Description of "account_status" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, call_api, get_payment_url · Private data: call_api, register, account_status, get_payment_url · Public sink: search_catalog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, call_api, get_payment_url · Private data: call_api, register, account_status, get_payment_url · Public sink: search_catalog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
